links.rules: land = economic road lanes and land borders; maritime = economic sea lanes only (never army movement); movement = land movement between playable provinces only (simulated countries and blocs cannot be entered in v1)

world.rules: tariff fitted to customs duties kept by national government (EU members: duties are EU revenue, tariff 0); bank profit paid to bank owners (households), not the treasury; blocs are economic aggregates without unrest or regime change; state ownership shares of the goods catalogue scaled to observed dividend income (D42)

startingRelations.rule: neutral: every pair of diplomatic actors at 0; blocs have no diplomacy

military.status: illustrative starting forces: counts by the approved Rule W (D3, M-2) with a documented gameplay assumption for Türkiye; placement by the approved rule P-1 (provisional gameplay configuration). Not a historical order of battle. Military gameplay is not enabled by this package.

parameter.method: Game-scale parameter approved by the owner (M-2), not a historical fact

fra.method: Rule W (approved D3, M-2): defence compensation of employees (COFOG 02, D1) / (whole-economy compensation / employees) / 25,000

tur.method: Gameplay assumption (licence-clean): Türkiye's personnel equivalents per inhabitant = the median of the other five playable countries (Rule W), times the population of its nine provinces, / 25,000
tur.replaces: Rule W with the Ministry of Treasury and Finance budget inputs (approved M-3), held back until that source is cleared for redistribution (W5-L1)
tur.reason: No licence-clean 2023 source gives Türkiye's defence pay or defence spending: SIPRI (via WDI) is restricted, NATO publishes no reuse terms, the Ministry tables have no reuse licence, Eurostat and the OECD have no Turkish defence data.

placement.status: provisional gameplay configuration (owner decision P-1); illustrative, not a historical order of battle
placement.method: one division per reachable province; the remainder by population x (1 + frontier), largest remainder (scenarios/pipeline/military_placement.py)
placement.isolation: Under the current movement rules the UK, Türkiye and four islands cannot engage other countries: accepted for the prototype only (P-2)
